concerns.text: T051 records `reproducibility_hash` (SHA-256 of the entire `data/` tree) BEFORE T072 runs, but T072 then re-runs the full pipeline (`--generate --compress --analyze`) and confirms artifacts in `data/results/` — any re-run that rewrites `run_metrics.json` (wall-clock times, SC-005) or other data files will change the data/ tree and invalidate the hash T051 just recorded. Either move the final hashing into/after T072's verification run, or have T072 verify byte-identity against the pre-hash and explicitly state that no data/ file is rewritten (run_metrics.json wall-clock time makes byte-identity unlikely). As ordered, the state registry's hash is stale on arrival.

T051 is tagged [P] and listed in Phase 2 alongside T067, but its stated dependencies are 'T070, T067' — it cannot start until T067 (same phase, listed after it) completes. The [P] tag is only safe with respect to T071; the intra-phase placement after its dependency T067 is correct but the tag without qualification is misleading. Clarify that [P] means parallel with T071 only.
